rows.summary: Staged content can escape inspection when working bytes are clean.
rows.evidence: workingEntry hashes indexObject but reads only working bytes; rev-list does not include index-only objects. Inspect indexed bytes, path rules and mode, and add regression coverage.

rows.summary: A subdirectory invocation can omit sibling working content.
rows.evidence: ls-files is relative to cwd and no repository-root guard exists. Reject non-root invocation using canonical paths and test the nested declarations case.

rows.summary: Historical symlinks are not marked unsupported.
rows.evidence: treeFindings handles mode160000 only, while current links are blocked. Apply the existing category to mode120000 and test committed/deleted links.

rows.summary: Object contents are not authenticated against their advertised IDs.
rows.evidence: readBatch validates headers, sizes and framing but not the canonical object hash. Authenticate SHA1/SHA256 objects and prove corruption refusal.

rows.summary: Encrypted and DSA PEM private-key forms escape the detector.
rows.evidence: The PEM alternative lists RSA, EC and OPENSSH only. Extend the existing signature with the demonstrated standard header forms and test them.

rows.summary: Synthetic-home exclusions also exempt suffixed account names.
rows.evidence: The negative lookahead uses word boundaries, which terminate before punctuation inside an account component. Require an exact synthetic component and test suffix cases.

rows.summary: Multiword employer terms miss hyphen/underscore host and repository spellings.
rows.evidence: containsTerm preserves literal spaces after camel segmentation, so the demonstrated separated spelling is missed. Normalize only supported separators while preserving complete-term boundaries.

rows.summary: A future validated asset may remain permanently blocked.
rows.evidence: Every detection is unresolved and report verification forbids manual flips. This is correct for the actual unreviewed assets; no approved asset/provenance input has been supplied to demonstrate an acceptance failure. A real fingerprint-bound validation record and the intended consuming workflow would settle the prospective medium-impact limitation.

rows.summary: The timeout fixture path is not decoded as a native path.
rows.evidence: URL.pathname retains URL escaping and Windows drive syntax. Use fileURLToPath; no Windows execution claim follows from this source repair.

rows.summary: A temporary-file collision deletes a preexisting file.
rows.evidence: writeFile uses wx, but finally removes the pathname even when creation failed. Track successful creation and retain collision bytes in a regression.

rows.summary: A nested-root scan can accept incomplete current scope.
rows.evidence: Independently traced ls-files cwd behavior and absent root guard; same demonstrated defect as blind-2, with the same canonical-root repair.

rows.summary: Sensitive staged content can receive an accepted verdict.
rows.evidence: The staged blob is absent from inspected working bytes and all-ref closure; same defect as blind-1, repaired by exact indexed-content inspection.

rows.summary: History-only symlinks incorrectly leave contentComplete true.
rows.evidence: Historical mode120000 lacks the existing unsupported-link category; same defect as blind-3, repaired without following the target.

rows.summary: Ref-name privacy detection lacks a regression assertion.
rows.evidence: Pre-verified: removing the ref textCategories call leaves all runnable tests passing. Add clean-object/sensitive-ref coverage at the outer publication verdict.

rows.summary: Historical gzip inspection lacks a scanner-level regression assertion.
rows.evidence: Pre-verified: bypassing historical gzip inspection leaves all runnable tests passing. Add a committed/deleted gzip fixture and exact historical blob assertion.

rows.summary: Scanner tests do not certify actual repository privacy or redistribution.
rows.evidence: Confirmed pre-existing asset/copied-material provenance and historical privacy remain unknown. The report already refuses clearance; retain maintainer-owned substantive review rather than infer it from synthetic tests.

rows.summary: The retained publication report describes the earlier candidate.
rows.evidence: Confirmed its revision and current findings predate the resume correction. Regenerate and independently compare after all final source/evidence/index writes; this changes no acceptance rule.

rows.summary: Offline validation does not prove complete live reader and lifecycle execution.
rows.evidence: Documented CLI parsers and executable identities pass; lifecycle relays were deliberately not invoked and no live reader failure is demonstrated. Native Windows and an authorized disposable live reader/lifecycle scenario would settle any prospective medium-impact defect.

rows.summary: A standalone verdict is not yet wired into release automation.
rows.evidence: The invoked story is 8.7: its binding cross-story contract explicitly supplies an invocable verdict for 8.8. It performs no release/publication, so absence of the next story consumer is not a missing 8.7 execution path.

rows.summary: The aggregate is still incomplete.
rows.evidence: The review snapshot predates completion. The same unchanged rerun has now exited0: root167pass/2skip,3159coverage,14serial audit,261a11y and all eight floors; the actual completion log and outcomes supersede the in-progress snapshot without erasing the first failure.

rows.summary: Substantive approval is a limitation rather than an exercised resolution mechanism.
rows.evidence: Same prospective concern as blind-8. Actual assets have no supplied validated provenance, so unresolved output is required. A real approved, fingerprint-bound input and its acceptance contract are needed to demonstrate whether a future resolution consumer is missing.

patchStatus: All11 source/test groups applied and parent full verification passed; final report group is regenerated and independently checked after metadata/index finalization.
